description_short: The University of Cambridge EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Sensor Technologies and Applications offers a combined MRes and PhD starting October 2027. The funding deadline for all applicants, including international, is 6 January 2027; first-round interviews run late January to February 2027.
